propositions: Seam-crossing test lacks end-to-end coverage of the apply-to-differ path: differ tests seed state via _StubBindingStore while apply tests seed synthetic payloads, each layer testing only what the other is supposed to establish.

Existing comment recording test (test_comment_id_acli_envelope.py) posts real envelope and re-diffs one store but provides no unrecorded-control or inert-guard variant to discriminate is_comment_mapped behavior.

A recorded comment must be skipped on re-diff against the same BindingStore instance, while an unrecorded control comment must still be emitted, with body divergence preventing secondary skip from masking primary skip.
Forcing is_comment_mapped to False must re-emit a recorded comment, proving the seam assertion depends on the guard rather than passing vacuously.
